sourceType: AAST technical guideline summarizing AASM manual PAP titration guidance
editionStatus: Updated July 2021; listed on the current AAST technical-guidelines index
authorityBoundary: Use as a sleep-technologist workflow overlay for PAP recording parameters, CPAP/BPAP titration, split-night workflow, documentation, and supplemental oxygen during PAP titration. Current AASM scoring rules and active AASM treatment guidance override conflicting older material. Do not use this source as the treatment authority for CSA/ASV, and do not generalize its PAP-specific oxygen procedure into a universal oxygen algorithm.
bestFor: Technologist PAP titration workflow, patient preparation, education, interface fitting, CPAP/BPAP concepts, event-response framework, split-night workflow, treatment-response assessment, supplemental oxygen during PAP titration, and documentation.

mappingRationale.D2B: Supports procedure execution and monitoring during PAP titration.
mappingRationale.D2C: Supports technologist response, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and treatment-response observations.
mappingRationale.D4A: Directly addresses PAP administration and CPAP/BPAP titration workflow.
mappingRationale.D4C: Provides current technologist workflow for supplemental oxygen specifically during PAP titration, subordinate to the order, facility protocol, and current applicable AASM guidance.
